Klasse GameUtils

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.GameUtils
public class GameUtils extends Object
The GameUtils is a utility class that provides independent and mostly context free helper methods for information gathering and game logic.

They are implemented as static methods so they can be accessed without initializing an instance of the class.

GameUtils is divided in different nested classes that group the related functionality to improve the overview and readability.

The inner classes are:

  • GameUtils.Ring, collects methods related to the ring,
  • GameUtils.Analysis, collects analytical helper methods,
  • GameUtils.Combat, collects methods related to combat,
  • GameUtils.MathAndRandom, provides mathematical and random methods.
